comments.text: Durian is truly one of nature's wonders. I only started to love it after eating it 5 times, it is definitely an acquired taste. I love how it's a fruit which people either love or hate so intensely, and its thorny shell is just a sight to behold. Whoever could have guessed that such a delicious pudding exists within such a hard, dangerous exterior.
